sentences.text: "Since I've started here, I play games a lot less at home, but because I play in such a different way at work to what I'm playing at home, I can still enjoy it." West uses her skills with a controller to explore choices and scenarios that developers may not have captured on video.

Many games, like Grand Theft Auto VI, feature large sprawling worlds for players to explore When playing games in her own time West hates hurting NPCs, but admits at work: "Unfortunately I have to be a bit evil sometimes".
sentences.article_title: Who decides that Grand Theft Auto is for adults only?

sentences.text: She will typically play a game for several days, checking for blood, suggestive costumes and potentially exploitative in-game purchases.

sentences.text: Millwall, who are 16th in the Championship, have average league gates of 19,418 at The Den this season Millwall have been ordered to play a future Championship match in front of a partially-closed stadium as punishment for fans' discriminatory chants.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: The club has also been fined £70,000 by an independent regulatory commission, and been told another offence this season will lead to a further partial stadium closure.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: The sanctions were imposed for ableist and homophobic chants, heard at a game against Charlton Athletic in January.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: "These chants are discriminatory, unacceptable, and will not be tolerated at The Den or anywhere Millwall play," Millwall's managing director Mark Fairbrother said in an open letter to supporters. , external "The club condemns them without reservation.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: They do not represent this club, and the vast majority of supporters who follow Millwall home and away with passion and pride.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: It is the first time a club has been given this level of sanction for discriminatory chanting, with the commission saying "the club's previous disciplinary record was a significant aggravating feature".
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: "History has shown that combinations of action plans and fines have been wholly ineffective to prevent the club - through its supporters - committing breaches" of Football Association (FA) rules around discriminatory behaviour, the commission added.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: The FA had charged Millwall in March for the chanting against Charlton.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: The club admitted the charge, and in its submissions suggested the chants were limited to 80 to 100 individuals in the north-eastern corner of the Dockers Stand, in the blocks that will be closed as part of the punishment.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: However, based on other evidence, the commission concluded the actual figure involved in the chants was "likely to have been in the hundreds, quite possibly more".
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: It also found that the club did not make any announcement over the stadium PA system ordering for the discriminatory chanting to stop, nor did it deploy any additional stewards or police to the areas from where the chanting was originating.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: This is a serious outcome," Fairbrother said.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: "This significant sanction was given because, although this is the first charge relating to a match at The Den for many years, the commission took into account a number of incidents of discriminatory chanting involving our supporters over the past few seasons at away games.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: "This is the cumulative cost of that pattern.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: Most importantly, the current and any future sanctions mean the next incident won't just cost the club money.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: It will cost supporters their seats.
sentences.article_title: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants

sentences.text: The visuals of the historic trilateral meeting may be the only lasting impression left by the summit Donald Trump went into his trilateral meeting with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping with little on the agenda and no clear asks – and he left with little in return.

sentences.text: In the end, the visuals of the meeting – the "optics", as political wags like to say – may be the only lasting impression from the summit, billed by some as a historic "Yalta 2.0" meeting of great powers.
sentences.article_title: Analysis: Trilateral summit high on spectacle, short on substance

sentences.text: The pomp and the ceremony, in the end, may be what the US president wanted most.
sentences.article_title: Analysis: Trilateral summit high on spectacle, short on substance

sentences.text: Trump, bruised by his Republican Party's drubbing in midterm congressional elections earlier this month, clearly relished the global spotlight during his three-day trip to Asia and the historic nature of the first-ever US-Russia-China trilateral meeting.
sentences.article_title: Analysis: Trilateral summit high on spectacle, short on substance

sentences.article_title: Analysis: Trilateral summit high on spectacle, short on substance

sentences.article_title: Analysis: Trilateral summit high on spectacle, short on substance
